name: @mcp-warden/cli
stderr:
Local-first credential broker for AI agents.

Usage: mcp-warden <COMMAND>

Commands:
  init      First-run setup — create the config directory and a template config file
  secret    Manage secrets stored in the OS keychain
  preset    Define and inspect presets (named, scoped actions)
  audit     Show recent audit log entries (read-only — append-only by design)
  approval  Set the approval policy for a preset
  mcp       Run the MCP server over stdio (consumed by the AI agent)
  doctor    Print a diagnostic summary of the current configuration. Pass `--deep` to additionally run safe read-only probes for each preset
  run       Launch a wrapped MCP server (`[[server]]` in the config) with its keys injected from the keychain. Use it as the server's command in your MCP client config instead of writing the key there
  scan      Find plaintext secrets in MCP client configs (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code, Codex) and `.env` files. Read-only; shows where they are and what they look like, never their values
  import    Move the keys `scan` marks importable (`env` of stdio MCP servers) into the keychain, and point each client entry at `mcp-warden run`
  server    Manage wrapped MCP servers for `mcp-warden run`
  lock      Kill switch: every MCP server refuses every call from its next one on
  unlock    Remove the lock after a human approves it (dialog / notification / Telegram). Servers that saw the lock stay locked until they restart
  web       Start a local read-only web UI (binds 127.0.0.1 only)
  help      Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version
